project.name: Mortagate — Microsoft Copilot Cowork Plugin
project.notes: Created 2026-08-28 (ADR-36 follow-up). mortagate.gates.json describes the deprecated Salesforce implementation and does not apply to this product. This file's commands assume PR #6 (branch feat/microsoft-cowork-plugin) is merged -- microsoft-cowork/ does not exist on main yet, so none of these checks can run until then.

phases.name: Package Structure Readiness
phases.intent: Confirm the Cowork app package exists and is structurally valid before any tenant-side action.
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json exists and parses as valid JSON.
All four skill directories exist with SKILL.md frontmatter.
Icon assets exist and are valid PNGs at the required dimensions.

checks.notes: Offline structural validator already exists in the module source (PR #6) -- this gate just wires it into a runnable check, it doesn't invent new validation logic.

phases.name: Planning Documentation Readiness
phases.intent: Confirm the Cowork-scoped planning artifacts exist -- the same discipline mortagate.gates.json applied to the deprecated product, kept for this one.
acceptance_criteria: Epic exists in the live backlog.

phases.name: Package Build and Local CI
phases.intent: Confirm the package builds and existing local checks pass. NOTE: as of 2026-08-28, .github/workflows/ci.yml has zero jobs that touch microsoft-cowork/ -- the four jobs it runs (validate-salesforce, validate-agents, lwc-tests, no-secrets) are repo-wide and happen to execute on any PR including #6, but none of them validate the Cowork package itself. That gap is real and is not closed by this gate file; a Cowork CI job is a separate, not-yet-done follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit manifest validation passes.
Package builds to a zip without errors.
LWC unit tests pass (repo-wide, not Cowork-specific, but currently the only automated test signal touching this PR).

checks.notes: Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit CLI. Requires teamsapp/atk installed; not yet wired into CI.
Repo-wide, not Cowork-specific. Kept because it's the existing signal; do not treat a pass here as evidence Cowork itself is tested.

phases.name: Tenant Validation (manual, not automatable)
phases.intent: The one gate that cannot run from this environment. Requires a Frontier-enabled Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant and a licensed human.
acceptance_criteria: Package uploaded to a Frontier-enabled tenant by a licensed user.
All four skills appear and are invocable in Cowork.
No manifest or permission errors on upload.

checks.notes: US-6.6. Cannot be executed by an agent session -- interactive M365 sign-in required. See GOAL-G3-cowork-pilot-readiness.md.
